fundamentals.name: ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The index seeks to offer exposure to market volatility through publicly traded futures markets and is designed to measure the implied volatility of the S&P 500 over 30 days in the future.

news.paragraph: UVXY, an ETF designed to track volatility, has been the subject of recent articles discussing its leveraged strategy for uncertain times and its utility as a hedging tool. While older articles from late 2023 and early 2025 highlight its role in trading volatility around Fed decisions and its CFD offering, more recent pieces from early 2026 suggest that the 'good things do not last' for leveraged volatility strategies. The sentiment leans towards caution regarding its long-term viability and performance.
